name: ssg-node-tools
description: Node modules of the tools: what the scripts of the target sites import (Alpine.js, Turbo; versions follow docs/package.json), the CMS editor's libraries and type checker (crates/cms/web; tools/cms/build.sh), and the DOM its tests render the editor in (happy-dom, crates/cms/tests/js). Installed by tools/dev/node.sh (docs/rust-port/REWRITE_PLAN.md §7.2).
